summary.scope: 34 currently Maven-mapped CVEs in the Spring example's runtime SBOM and JAR scan, excluding Tomcat and Jackson. Includes the Angus SMTP JAR-only finding.
summary.measurement: CVE List cveMetadata.datePublished to the first GitHub advisory-database reviewed export commit containing the exact Maven coordinate. Every immediate unreviewed predecessor has an empty affected array. Git commit dates are timestamped repository evidence, not exact OSV API ingestion times or the first package-coordinate publication anywhere.
summary.mappingCorrectness: Coordinate presence is measured, not the correctness or completeness of affected version ranges.
summary.firstPublicationCounterexample: CVE-2026-84939 already had Maven package names and package URLs in its initial CVE List record; the later GitHub date is enrichment of the reviewed feed.
